name: 热带雨林
era: 赤道附近（亚马孙、刚果、东南亚）
eraEn: Near the equator (Amazon, Congo, SE Asia)
oneLiner: 全年高温多雨，物种密度全球最高，却土壤贫瘠——养分循环几乎全在生物体内。
oneLinerEn: Hot and wet all year with the highest species density on Earth, yet poor soils — nutrients cycle almost entirely within living biomass.

positions.v: 年降水量 >2000mm，无明显旱季，温度稳定。
positions.vEn: Rainfall >2000mm, no real dry season, stable temperatures.

positions.v: 乔木层、林下层、灌木、地被形成垂直结构。
positions.vEn: Emergent, canopy, understory and floor form vertical structure.

positions.v: 强淋溶使养分流失，靠枯落物快速分解回补。
positions.vEn: Heavy leaching drains nutrients; rapid litter decay recycles them.

why: 地球之肺与碳库，调节全球气候；其消失会放大温室效应并带走无数未命名物种。
whyEn: Earth's lungs and carbon store; its loss amplifies warming and erases countless unnamed species.

name: 热带草原
era: 热带雨林南北两侧（非洲、南美、澳洲）
eraEn: Either side of the rainforest (Africa, S. America, Australia)
oneLiner: 干湿季分明，草为主、疏树点缀；支撑着地球上规模最大的野生动物迁徙。
oneLinerEn: Distinct wet and dry seasons, grass-dominated with scattered trees; supports Earth's largest wildlife migrations.

positions.v: 年降水 500–1500mm，集中于雨季。
positions.vEn: 500–1500mm, concentrated in the wet season.

positions.v: 周期性野火维持草优势、抑制乔木。
positions.vEn: Periodic fires maintain grass dominance and check trees.

why: 既是重要牧业与碳储存区，也是人象、草食动物与掠食者共演化的舞台。
whyEn: Both a pastoral and carbon-storage zone, and the stage where herbivores, predators and humans co-evolve.

name: 荒漠（沙漠）
era: 副热带高压与雨影区（撒哈拉、戈壁、澳洲内陆）
eraEn: Subtropical highs & rain shadows (Sahara, Gobi, inland Australia)
oneLiner: 年降水 <250mm，蒸发远大于降水；生命以耐旱与昼夜剧温为生存法则。
oneLinerEn: Under 250mm a year, evaporation far exceeds rainfall; life survives by drought-tolerance and wild day-night temperature swings.

positions.v: 白天酷热、夜间骤冷，年温差大。
positions.vEn: Scorching days, sharp nights; large annual ranges.

positions.v: 植物深根、动物夜行与节水代谢。
positions.vEn: Deep-rooted plants, nocturnal and water-conserving animals.

why: 占陆地约三成，却是太阳能与矿产宝库；荒漠化扩张正威胁半干旱边境。
whyEn: About a third of land, yet a treasury of solar energy and minerals; expanding desertification threatens semi-arid margins.

name: 温带落叶林
era: 中纬度（东亚、北美东部、欧洲）
eraEn: Mid-latitudes (East Asia, eastern N. America, Europe)
oneLiner: 四季分明，树木冬季落叶以抗寒；降水均匀，土壤较肥沃，人类聚居密集。
oneLinerEn: Four clear seasons, trees shed leaves to survive winter; even rainfall and fairly fertile soils host dense human settlement.

positions.v: 春夏生长、秋冬休眠，物候节律强。
positions.vEn: Grow in spring-summer, dormant in autumn-winter.

positions.v: 落叶层厚，有机质积累，肥力较高。
positions.vEn: Thick leaf litter builds organic matter and fertility.

why: 全球人口与农业核心带，也最易被城市与耕地取代，原生林残存稀少。
whyEn: The demographic and agricultural core of the world, yet most easily replaced by cities and cropland; little primary forest remains.

name: 北方针叶林（泰加林）
era: 高纬度亚欧—北美（俄国、加拿大、北欧）
eraEn: High latitudes, Eurasia–N. America (Russia, Canada, N. Europe)
oneLiner: 耐寒针叶树广布，是全球面积最大的森林，也是巨大的碳与淡水储库。
oneLinerEn: Cold-hardy conifers stretch across the largest forest on Earth — a giant store of carbon and fresh water.

positions.v: 冬季漫长严寒，夏季短暂凉爽。
positions.vEn: Long frigid winters, short cool summers.

positions.v: 泥炭与冻土锁住大量碳。
positions.vEn: Peat and permafrost lock vast carbon.

why: 调节全球碳与气候的关键缓冲；冻土融化可能释放巨量温室气体。
whyEn: A key buffer regulating global carbon and climate; thawing permafrost may release vast greenhouse gases.

name: 苔原
eraEn: Polar regions and above the mountain treeline
oneLiner: 低温、生长季极短、无乔木；地衣苔藓为主，下层多为永冻土。
oneLinerEn: Cold, a very short growing season and no trees; lichens and mosses dominate over permafrost.

positions.v: 年均温低于 0℃，冻融循环强。
positions.vEn: Mean below 0°C with strong freeze-thaw cycles.

positions.v: 土壤常年冻结，限制根系与工程。
positions.vEn: Permanently frozen soil limits roots and construction.

why: 对升温最敏感的生态系统之一，冻土碳释放与反照率变化反馈全球气候。
whyEn: Among the most warming-sensitive ecosystems; permafrost carbon release and albedo shifts feed back on global climate.

name: 地中海气候
era: 大陆西岸中纬（地中海、加州、智利中部的海岸）
eraEn: Mid-latitude west coasts (Mediterranean, California, central Chile)
oneLiner: 夏干热、冬温和多雨，是橄榄、葡萄与人类文明最偏爱的海岸带之一。
oneLinerEn: Hot dry summers, mild rainy winters — one of the coastlines most favored by olives, vines and human civilization.

positions.v: 雨热不同期，夏季干燥。
positions.vEn: Rain and heat out of phase; dry summers.

positions.v: 硬叶常绿灌丛（如地中海夏旱灌木）。
positions.vEn: Sclerophyll evergreen shrubs.

why: 宜居与农业价值极高，却长期面临缺水、野火与城市扩张压力。
whyEn: Highly livable and agriculturally valuable, yet long pressed by water scarcity, wildfires and sprawl.

name: 高山带
era: 高海拔（喜马拉雅、安第斯、落基）
oneLiner: 随海拔上升气温与氧分压下降，植被呈垂直带谱；是亚洲大河的「水塔」。
oneLinerEn: Temperature and oxygen fall with altitude, giving vertical life zones; the 'water towers' of Asia's great rivers.

positions.v: 从森林到草甸、裸岩、雪线分层。
positions.vEn: Bands from forest to meadow, bare rock and snowline.

positions.v: 冰川与积雪补给下游数十亿人。
positions.vEn: Glaciers and snow feed billions downstream.

why: 下游水安全与生物多样性所系；冰川退缩正削弱这一调节作用。
whyEn: Underpins downstream water security and biodiversity; glacial retreat weakens this regulation.

name: 冰川与冰盖
era: 极地与高山（南极、格陵兰、喜马拉雅）
oneLiner: 以自身重量运动的冰体与冰原，是地球的淡水水库与气候记录仪。
oneLinerEn: Ice masses moving under their own weight — Earth's freshwater reservoirs and climate archives.

positions.v: 积雪经压实、重结晶成冰，在重力下沿运动。
positions.vEn: Snow compacts and recrystallizes into ice that flows under gravity.

positions.v: 刨蚀形成 U 形谷、冰碛地貌；融水补给河流。
positions.vEn: Erodes U-shaped valleys and moraines; meltwater feeds rivers.

why: 储存全球大部分淡水，调节海平面与河流供水；变暖下萎缩威胁水源与沿海城市。
whyEn: Holds most of the world's freshwater and modulates sea level and river supply; retreat threatens water sources and coasts.

name: 板块构造
oneLiner: 岩石圈板块在地幔对流上缓慢移动，塑造了山脉、海沟、地震与火山的全部分布。
oneLinerEn: Lithospheric plates drift on mantle convection, shaping where mountains, trenches, quakes and volcanoes occur.

positions.v: 张裂（洋中脊）、俯冲（海沟）、平错（转换断层）。
positions.vEn: Divergent (ridges), convergent (trenches), transform (faults).

positions.v: 地幔热对流与板块重力拖拽驱动每年数厘米运动。
positions.vEn: Mantle convection and slab pull drive centimetre-per-year motion.

why: 现代地理学的统一理论，解释了大陆漂移、造山带、地震带与矿产分布的成因。
whyEn: The unifying theory of geology, explaining continental drift, mountain belts, earthquake zones and ore distribution.

name: 水循环
oneLiner: 蒸发、水汽输送、降水、径流与下渗构成的闭合循环，驱动淡水的时空更新。
oneLinerEn: A closed loop of evaporation, transport, precipitation, runoff and infiltration that renews fresh water in time and space.

positions.v: 蒸发蒸腾→凝结降水→地表与地下径流→回归海洋。
positions.vEn: Evapotranspiration → condensation/precipitation → surface & groundwater runoff → back to sea.

positions.v: 取水、水库、城市化与气候改变局部分配。
positions.vEn: Abstraction, dams, urbanization and warming reshape local distribution.

why: 维系生命与农业、调节气候与地貌；水资源时空不均是其分布的核心矛盾。
whyEn: Sustains life, farming and climate and sculpts landforms; uneven space-time supply is water's core scarcity tension.

name: 洋流
oneLiner: 盛行风与密度差驱动的海水大规模流动，调节全球热量与气候。
oneLinerEn: Wind- and density-driven seawater flow that redistributes heat and climate globally.

positions.v: 暖流增温增湿、寒流降温减湿；风海流与密度流。
positions.vEn: Warm currents heat and moisten, cold cool and dry; wind-driven and density-driven.

positions.v: 温盐环流将热量由高纬输送、联结各大洋。
positions.vEn: The thermohaline conveyor moves heat poleward and links the oceans.

why: 影响沿岸气候、渔场分布与航运，并是地球热量平衡与碳吸收的关键环节。
whyEn: Shapes coastal climates, fisheries and shipping, and is key to Earth's heat balance and carbon uptake.

name: 季风
era: 南亚、东南亚与中国东部
oneLiner: 海陆热力差异使风向季节反转，带来集中而年际波动显著的雨季。
oneLinerEn: Land–sea heating flips winds by season, delivering concentrated and highly variable rainy seasons.

positions.v: 夏季陆低风从海洋吹向陆地带来降水。
positions.vEn: Summer low pressure draws moist wind from sea to land.

positions.v: 来得早晚与强弱决定洪涝或干旱。
positions.vEn: Its timing and strength decide floods or droughts.

why: 养活了世界最密集的稻作人口，其强弱直接关系到南亚与东亚的农业与水安全。
whyEn: Sustains the world's densest rice-growing populations; its strength directly drives South and East Asian farming and water security.

name: 珊瑚礁
era: 热带浅海（印度洋—太平洋）
oneLiner: 珊瑚虫与藻类共生的活体建筑，是海洋中的热带雨林，生物多样性极高。
oneLinerEn: Living structures of coral–algae symbiosis — the rainforests of the sea, with immense biodiversity.

positions.v: 水温 23–29℃、光照充足、盐度稳定的浅海。
positions.vEn: Warm (23–29°C), well-lit, stable-salinity shallow water.

positions.v: 升温白化、酸化、污染与过度捕捞。
positions.vEn: Warming bleaching, acidification, pollution and overfishing.

why: 庇护海洋物种、保护海岸并支撑渔业与旅游；对升温最敏感，是气候变化的前哨。
whyEn: Shelters marine life, buffers coasts and supports fisheries and tourism; highly warmth-sensitive, it is a frontline of climate change.

name: 喀斯特地貌
era: 石灰岩广布区（中国西南、地中海岸）
oneLiner: 可溶岩石被水长期溶蚀形成的地貌，多峰林、溶洞、天坑与地下河。
oneLinerEn: Landforms from dissolving soluble rock by water — tower karst, caves, sinkholes and underground rivers.

positions.v: 含 CO₂ 的水溶蚀碳酸钙，沿裂隙扩大洞穴。
positions.vEn: CO₂-charged water dissolves calcium carbonate along fractures into caves.

positions.v: 石林、峰林、洼地、钟乳石与地下河。
positions.vEn: Stone forests, peaks, dolines, stalactites and subterranean rivers.

why: 塑造独特景观与地下水系，却土层薄、易石漠化，是生态治理的难点。
whyEn: Creates striking scenery and groundwater systems but thin, desertification-prone soils, making it a hard case for ecological care.
